preconditions.description: The number of positions n is between 1 and 60000 inclusive.
The number of die faces m is between 4 and 100000 inclusive.
The number of turns k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= n for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: Each field transition value f_i is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_j < M for p_j in p)
preconditions.description: Each die face probability p_j is between 0 and M-1 inclusive.
The sum of all die face probabilities modulo M is 1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n probabilities.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i < M for x_i in probabilities)
postconditions.description: Each probability x_i is between 0 and M-1 inclusive.
The sum of all probabilities modulo M is 1.
